title: The Wizard returns: Fire, Frost and Thunder
changes: The Wizard can be played again, rebuilt around three schools of magic with one spell each for now: Fire Bolt, Blizzard (a storm around you that hurts and slows) and Thunder (lightning hammers the spot you pick).

New keyboard option in the menu (Esc): spell keys. Spells go on W E R T 1 2 3 4 5, the mouse walks, C opens the bag, D and F drink healing and mana potions, H is your character, K your skills, G uses things and X rolls.
Old wizard skills are gone: their points come back to spend on the new spells.
